title: Gene Marshall Doll Sunset Celebration Button Pin Ashton-Drake Signed Mel Odom
descriptionText: This unique pinback button celebrates the Gene Marshall Doll's Sunset Celebration, an event that any collector would love to attend. The pinback features the Ashton-Drake logo and is signed by Mel Odom, the creator of the Gene Marshall Doll. Perfect for any collector of collectible pinbacks or dolls, this item is a must-have addition to any collection. Made in Mexico, this pinback is not handmade and is the perfect addition to any collection.
